title: Extreme Quantile Treatment Effects beyond the Sample Range under Vanishing Overlap
banked_reason: The headline sharp uniform frontier and attaining interval are explicitly unresolved; the delivered nonmatching lower/upper bracket is a weaker substituted object.
gap_reasons: The headline sharp uniform frontier and attaining interval are explicitly unresolved; the delivered nonmatching lower/upper bracket is a weaker substituted object.
These results do not yet give a matched minimax frontier.
The established score theorem and the nonmatching bracket are evidence for it, not a resolution.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived boundary identification, legal multiscale lower constructions, a conservative observable interval, and a rank-integrated score candidate. Three D0 solve rounds did not close the polynomial gap between the lower and upper rates; D0.5 found that the delivered nonmatching bracket substituted for the promised sharp frontier. A future attempt needs a uniform target-diameter bound for the score inversion or a new legal bounded-divergence lower construction, along with repairs to four local proof findings.
tldr: The target \(p_n=n^{-2}\) lies beyond direct observation while treated information near \(x=0\) vanishes with \(\epsilon_n\).  Under the unchanged model, the paper proves boundary identification, legal observed-law lower bounds, a computable conservative interval, and a density-free rank-integrated score whose true-candidate remainder bias is \(O(\!\sum_j h_jt_j)\) and whose shared-sample finite-sample radius is \(O(\{\sum_j[n h_j(\epsilon_n+h_j^2)t_j]^{-1}\}^{1/2})\).  These results do not yet give a matched minimax frontier.  The lower side has the \(n\epsilon_n^{5/2}\) transition and multiscale logarithm, whereas the conservative interval has the elbow \(n^{-1/6}\ell_n^{3/2}\) below \(\epsilon_n\asymp n^{-1/3}\ell_n^{-1}\) and \((n\epsilon_n)^{-1/4}\ell_n^{5/4}\) above it.  The sharp-frontier question therefore remains open: what is missing is a uniform separation and target-diameter theorem for the inverted scores, or a larger legal lower construction.  The rate \((n\epsilon)^{-1/3}\log n\) is sharp only on the exact-Pareto submodel with fixed positive \(\epsilon\).
gap: Conditional extreme-treatment-effect theory uses fixed positivity or stronger tail structure, weak-overlap quantile theory stops at marginal fixed or intermediate ranks, and honest tail inference has no spatially degenerating treatment design.
fill: The paper will identify the observed-law modulus across the overlap transition, test the observable multiscale cancellation lemma, and pair the resulting lower bound with a computable uniformly honest interval or revise the frontier through a legal counterexample.
